prompt:
Bold clean ink linework, flat vibrant cell-shaded colors, rounded expressive character designs, distinctive 1980s Akira Toriyama manga aesthetic. Create ONE finished landscape 1536x1024 comic panel, NOT a character sheet. Beijing present-day ordinary apartment, or 1967 radio station in flashbacks pages 4–6. Cel shading throughout, no watercolor.
SCENE: 풀 스프레드. 청신이 방으로 돌아옴. 왕먀오와 스치친이 그녀를 봄. 청신의 얼굴 — 70대의 주름, 눈물 자국. 그러나 눈빛은 맑다. 수십 년의 자기기만이 끝났다. EP001 p14 (blank area for later overlay)와 동일 구도 — 실루엣이 아닌 얼굴이 보임.
Visible named cast: 왕먀오, 청신, 스치친. Character sheets are identity references ONLY; never copy their backgrounds. Wang Miao always wears pale blue-grey shirt and dark trousers. All lettering and exact digits will be added later: NO readable text, numbers, symbols, balloons, captions or watermark in generated artwork. Clean coherent anatomy, strong ink composition, no extra characters or alien creatures. Non-graphic disaster where described.
